ISERROR over a range where one Value is wanted is refused, uncaught
cases.engineDiffersByDecision: ADR-0125: functions are not lifted over arrays yet; an array where the function wants one Value is #VALUE!, where Excel 365 lifts it and spills; ISERROR does not catch that refusal
ADR-0047: IFERROR and ISERROR do not catch #CIRC!, and a Formula whose text references a cycle member is #CIRC! whether or not the branch is taken

cases.description: ISERROR does not read a refused cell as an error: B1 is MROUND(0.15,0.1), refused, which Excel answered 0.2 (MROUND-003); what ISERROR(B1) gives is asked
cases.engineDiffersByDecision: ADR-0047 (2026-10-12, decided with the user: a refusal is never caught, anywhere): MROUND's fractional multiple is refused (ADR-0047), and a Formula that reads the refused cell is refused, where ISERROR gave TRUE before
